svg.title: MLOps
svg.desc: Follow a model from versioned Gold data through training, evaluation, registration, approved deployment and monitored feedback. Better metrics alone never authorize production. Original, illustrative documentation - not your factory's live state. Changing topics never changes your setup, saves files, signs in or reads Azure. Playback never deploys, approves a release, reads documents or calls a model. The configuration map's sample regions do not prescribe moving data between regions.

g.text: Follow a model from versioned Gold data through training, evaluation, registration, approved deployment and monitored feedback. Better
Begin with a trustworthy Gold snapshot.
Gold means curated data ready for an approved purpose, not an Azure resource type. In this fictional equipment example, predict failure risk
from past measurements. Version the snapshot, labels and feature code. Split by time or machine into training, validation and held-out test
data; fit transformations only on training data.
Keep the test set out of training and tuning. Data permissions and leakage checks still apply.
Follow a model from versioned Gold data through training, evaluation, registration, approved deployment and monitored feedback. Better
A training job learns patterns from the training partition. Use validation data to tune choices, and track the run's code, data version,
environment, parameters and metrics. Save the resulting model artifact with its producing run so another person can reproduce the
A completed training run is neither a registered model nor an approved deployment. This animation submits no jobs.
1 · GOLD DATA > TRAIN: Training partition only
Follow a model from versioned Gold data through training, evaluation, registration, approved deployment and monitored feedback. Better
Test on examples the model has not learned.
Evaluate the frozen candidate on held-out data with predefined workload thresholds. Check prediction quality, calibration, important
subgroups, safety and serving latency. Record evidence against the exact model and test-data versions. Keep the final test set independent of
Training accuracy is not held-out performance. A failed quality gate sends the candidate back for revision.
Follow a model from versioned Gold data through training, evaluation, registration, approved deployment and monitored feedback. Better
Does the candidate improve on what you have?
Compare with a simple baseline and the current model using the same permitted evaluation data and protocol. Review regressions,
uncertainty, cost and operational trade-offs, not just one accuracy number. If evidence is insufficient, retain the current model and
investigate rather than claiming a winner.
Comparison is evidence, not production approval. Better metrics do not automatically deploy a model.
Follow a model from versioned Gold data through training, evaluation, registration, approved deployment and monitored feedback. Better
Give the reviewed candidate an explicit version.
The responsible reviewer checks the model, evidence and permitted use before registering an explicit model version, for example in Azure
Machine Learning. Link it to the training run, data snapshot, feature code, environment and evaluation report so the asset has traceable
Registration records an asset; it does not create an endpoint or grant production approval.
1 · COMPARE > MODEL VERSION: Reviewed candidate + lineage
Follow a model from versioned Gold data through training, evaluation, registration, approved deployment and monitored feedback. Better
Approve the target change before deployment.
Validate that exact registered model in Stage with serving code and environment-specific configuration. Obtain separate production release
approval from the responsible owner before changing Prod. Choose an online endpoint or batch path, check access and capacity, plan
rollback or recovery, then record the deployed model version.
Model review and registration do not replace deployment approval. Playback never approves a release or deploys an endpoint.
1 · MODEL VERSION > DEPLOY: Separately approved release
Follow a model from versioned Gold data through training, evaluation, registration, approved deployment and monitored feedback. Better
Watch the deployed model and real outcomes.
Observe input drift, failures, latency, cost and prediction quality when reliable outcome labels arrive. Check subgroup performance and
training-serving feature consistency. Associate every observation with the deployed model version and investigate alerts against the agreed
Drift is a signal to investigate, not proof of failure or an automatic retraining or deployment instruction.
Follow a model from versioned Gold data through training, evaluation, registration, approved deployment and monitored feedback. Better
Improve deliberately, then repeat the gates.
Review observations with data owners, check rights and consent, and minimize sensitive information before admitting feedback to the next
Gold dataset. Version corrected labels and new evaluation cases. If retraining is justified, create a new candidate and repeat evaluation,
comparison, review and separate release approval.
Do not automatically copy private production data into training. Feedback never bypasses the next model or deployment gate.
2 · FEEDBACK > GOLD DATA: Permitted next snapshot
